summary: Verified the mobile Users-page overflow + icon-only Import CSV / Buy account fix on the Telegram Ultra panel. Logged in as iamhear/iamhear/iamhear on 390x844 and 360x740 and validated no horizontal page scroll, icon-only mobile labels, working dialogs and search, and desktop non-regression at 1920x800. Did NOT submit any dialogs or delete any accounts (LIVE DB).

issues: Inside individual account cards the top-right row 'flex items-center gap-1' (status badge + trash button) has boundingClientRect.right = 417px on a 390px viewport (and same on 360). It does NOT cause page-level horizontal scroll because the card clips it (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth on both widths), but the 'Needs my.telegram code' badge visually gets clipped/cut off at the right edge of narrow cards. Consider making the badge shrink/wrap or letting the card row use flex-wrap so the badge stays fully readable on <=390 screens. This is unrelated to the toolbar fix under review.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not blocking): the 'Needs my.telegram code' status badge on account cards gets visually clipped at 360-390px because the badge+trash row overflows the card. Add flex-wrap / truncate / shorter label on <sm to keep it fully visible.
critical_code_review_comments: accounts-section.tsx toolbar refactor (flex w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap + w-full sm:w-56 search) is correct and resolves the page-level horizontal overflow.

Import CSV and Buy account buttons correctly wrap their label in 'hidden sm:inline' so mobile renders icon-only while desktop keeps the label — verified visually and by inner_text() (mobile empty, desktop 'Import CSV' / 'Buy account').
seed_data_creation: None. LIVE Neon DB with 499 real Telegram accounts — only opened/closed dialogs, no submits/deletes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 covered the mobile Users-toolbar overflow bug fix. Verified: (a) documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth (390 and 360), (b) [data-testid=import-accounts-button] and [data-testid=buy-account-button] inner_text() is empty on mobile (icon only) and equals 'Import CSV'/'Buy account' on desktop, (c) search magnifier expands the input to w-full without page overflow and filters accounts, (d) both dialogs (Import CSV, Buy account) open on mobile and were closed via Escape without submitting. Section nav on mobile is behind a hamburger — the mobile-nav-* buttons live inside a collapsible sidebar; the second run started a fresh context so login was lost mid-check; but in the first run the Users page was reachable and no overflow was seen. One residual minor visual issue documented in design_issues.
